meta.source: re-authored in-house from each project's official documentation (wordpress.org, drupal.org, joomla.org, typo3.org); stage-arc structure follows the kali web-pentest cms phase conventions; goes beyond the chassis's wpscan/wpscan-audit op pair
meta.policy: methodology stage arcs + names + official doc links + re-authored purposes only; no payloads, exploit code, or evasion snippets; every link verified live at build time
